$comment: Provider registry for `empire signup`. Each provider: where to sign up, which plan, which credentials to collect (env), how to verify them, and where they plug into the empire. Facts flagged 'verify' were not confirmed against a live account at authoring time (2026-11-21).

providers.name: Cloudflare
providers.why: Already the backbone of MC96: Workers, D1, KV, R2, Workers AI, Pages, Access, Tunnels, DNS, Email Routing. One API token + wrangler login unlocks all of it for n8n, Forgejo, Gabriel and the nightly inventory.
providers.plan: Free tier runs all of the above; Workers Paid (USD 5/mo) as D1/Workers usage grows. Zero Trust free up to 50 users.

env.hint: Create Token → start from 'Edit Cloudflare Workers', then ADD Account: D1:Edit, Workers KV Storage:Edit, Workers R2 Storage:Edit, Cloudflare Pages:Edit, Access: Apps and Policies:Read, Cloudflare Tunnel:Read, Workers AI:Read, Account Settings:Read · Zone: Zone:Read, DNS:Edit, Email Routing Rules:Read — all accounts, all zones
Dashboard → Workers & Pages → right sidebar 'Account ID' (32 hex chars)

providers.n8n: Credentials → Cloudflare API (token) for Workers/D1 nodes; HTTP Request nodes use Header Auth Bearer.
steps: Sign in (or sign up) at dash.cloudflare.com with rsp@noizy.ai. Turn on 2FA — the empire's DNS lives here.
Copy the Account ID from Workers & Pages → overview sidebar.
Profile → API Tokens → Create Token → start from 'Edit Cloudflare Workers', add the permissions in the hint, scope to all accounts/zones, create, copy once.
Paste both when prompted; `empire signup cloudflare` verifies the token.
On GOD: `npm i -g wrangler && wrangler login` so every wrangler.toml in GABRIEL deploys from one identity.
Run `empire run --only cloudflare` — every zone, Worker, D1, KV, R2, Pages project, Access app and tunnel lands in empire/cloudflare-inventory.json.
usedBy: D1: mc96-central, aeon-god-kernel, noizylab-repairs, rsp-master-budget, gabriel-mcp-steps

providers.name: Proton
providers.why: Swiss, end-to-end encrypted home for the empire's identity: Mail (rsp@noizy.ai on a custom domain), Drive (encrypted off-site copy of AQUARIUM manifests + docs), Pass (every key from this sign-up lives there), Calendar, VPN. Private by default — matches the HVS / consent doctrine.
providers.plan: Proton Unlimited (Mail + Drive 500 GB + Pass + VPN, custom domains, Bridge). Proton Business Suite if staff mailboxes are needed. Bridge requires a paid plan.

env.hint: Bridge → account → Mailbox details → Username (your Proton address)
Bridge → Mailbox details → Password (Bridge-generated, NOT your login password)

cli.install: brew install --cask proton-mail-bridge proton-pass && brew install rclone
cli.login: rclone config → new remote 'proton' → type protondrive → username/password/2FA

providers.n8n: Credentials → IMAP (host 127.0.0.1, port 1143, STARTTLS, Bridge user/password) and SMTP (port 1025). n8n must reach the Bridge: run n8n on GOD with host networking, or point it at host.docker.internal.
steps: Create the account at account.proton.me (Unlimited). Write the recovery phrase down offline — not in Pass.
Add custom domain noizy.ai: Settings → Domain names → add → copy the DNS records → create them in Cloudflare DNS → verify → add rsp@noizy.ai.
Install Proton Mail Bridge on GOD, sign in, keep it running at login. Copy the Bridge mailbox password.
Install Proton Pass (Mac + iPhone). Create vault 'NOIZY Empire'. Every key `empire signup` collects goes in there too.
rclone config → remote 'proton' (protondrive) → `rclone about proton:` to confirm.
Paste Bridge user/password when prompted; `empire signup proton` checks the Bridge port.
providers.notes: Proton has no public REST API for Mail; Bridge (IMAP/SMTP) is the integration surface. Proton Drive via rclone `protondrive` backend (community-maintained; may lag Proton changes).

providers.name: Infomaniak
providers.why: Swiss, green, GDPR-strict hosting with a real REST API: kDrive (large encrypted-at-rest storage for AQUARIUM mirrors), kSuite mail/calendar/kMeet/kChat, Public Cloud (OpenStack VMs + S3 for Forgejo/n8n off-GOD), domains, Swiss Backup, Newsletter, and AI Tools — Swiss-hosted open LLMs/Whisper behind an OpenAI-compatible API: the sovereign fallback for Gabriel when Anthropic is unreachable.
providers.plan: kSuite Pro (mail + kDrive) or standalone kDrive Pro; AI Tools billed per token; Public Cloud pay-as-you-go.

env.hint: Manager → profile → Developer → API tokens → create 'NOIZY Empire' with drive, mail, ai, dns, backup scopes
Manager → AI Tools → product id in the URL (OpenAI-compatible endpoint needs it)
Your Infomaniak login email (kDrive WebDAV / rclone)
Manager → kDrive → Settings → Application passwords (not your login password)

cli.login: rclone config → webdav → url https://connect.drive.infomaniak.com/<DRIVE_ID> → vendor other → login email + application password; name 'kdrive'

providers.n8n: Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer $INFOMANIAK_TOKEN) for api.infomaniak.com; OpenAI credential with base URL https://api.infomaniak.com/1/ai/$INFOMANIAK_AI_PRODUCT_ID/openai for the AI Tools fallback.
steps: Create the Infomaniak account (company: Fish Music Inc, CA). Enable 2FA.
Order kSuite (or kDrive); note the Drive ID from the kDrive URL.
Manager → Developer → API tokens → create 'NOIZY Empire' with drive/mail/ai/dns scopes → copy once.
kDrive → Settings → Application passwords → create 'rclone GOD' → use with rclone webdav remote 'kdrive'.
AI Tools → enable → note the product id → `empire signup infomaniak` lists the models it can reach.
Paste token + IDs when prompted; verification calls /1/profile.
providers.notes: verify: AI Tools endpoint shape and token scopes against developer.infomaniak.com once the account exists. connect.drive.infomaniak.com is the documented kDrive WebDAV endpoint.

providers.name: TODAQ Micro (Qatom)
providers.why: Micropayments with 0% take rate and sub-second settlement for NOIZY content: pay-per-listen / pay-per-line voice assets, LIFELUV passes, agent-to-agent paywalls (Gabriel can sell and buy). Every payment settles as a TODA file with its own proof of provenance — an auditable receipt trail for voice IP.
providers.plan: Builder: free (1 agent, 5 items, 25 tx/mo). Pro: USD 20/mo. Max: USD 300/mo. 0% take rate; card top-ups via Stripe (≈ USD 0.50 min); cash-out by ACH to a US or Canadian bank (USD 1 flat, 10 USD-TDN min). Priced in USD-TDN (1 = USD 1); no CAD DQ found.

urls.signup: https://pay.m.todaq.net/v4/account  (POST, no auth — `empire signup todaq` does it)

env.hint: staging | production — staging has its own accounts and its own DQ
from POST /v4/account → secrets[].public_secret — safe for web pages (payment-js)
from POST /v4/twin → id (your wallet + merchant account)
digital quantity hash from GET /v4/dq (USD TDN)

cli.install: node ≥ 18 (fetch built in) — no SDK needed; browser: npm i @todaqmicro/payment-js@^0.5.6

providers.n8n: Header Auth Bearer (token minted by the Code node from client_id:client_secret Basic auth → POST /v4/account/oauth/token, 1 h). No webhooks exist: the browser `payment` event → your server → POST /v4/payment/{hash}/validate redeems once.
steps: `empire signup todaq` → POST /v4/account on STAGING, stores client_id / client_secret / public_secret (secret shown once — also put it in Proton Pass).
Same run: mints an OAuth token, reads GET /v4/dq, creates your twin (POST /v4/twin) and one test commodity ('NOIZY test line — 0.25').

Drop the payment element on a page: loadMicroPayments(PUBLIC_SECRET, {apiVersion:'main'}) → elements().create('payment',{hash}) → listen for `payment` on document → POST to your server → validate. (empire/accounts/todaq/README.md has the snippet.)
Buy test TDN on staging (load.m.todaq.net), pay your own item, confirm GET /v4/catalog/revenue moves.
Repeat with TODAQ_ENV=production. Cash-out and on-ramp: email support@todaq.net (Buy TDN 0.50–100 USD); keep RBC-backed reserve note for finance.

Install the Qatom Authenticator on the iPhone 15 Pro Max (2FA for buyer side); for LUCY, host the payment element in a WKWebView and relay the `payment` event to the Gabriel daemon (no native iOS SDK exists).
providers.notes: Rebranded Qatom (TODAQ Financial Inc, Toronto). Official Node SDK @todaqmicro/payment-node 0.4.0 targets the old /v2 API and logs secrets to console — do not use; empire/accounts/todaq/qatom.mjs calls /v4 directly. payment-ios / android / flutter repos are empty stubs. verify: KYC for cash-out, Console URL, buyer geography.
